name: yf_screener
description:
Yahoo Finance predefined stock screens (day gainers, losers, most active and others), through yfinance's Screener class.
Returns: {screen_type, count, results: up to 50 Yahoo quote objects} or {screen_type, error}.
Inputs (* required): screen_type (day_gainers, day_losers, most_actives, undervalued_large_caps, aggressive_small_caps, growth_technology_stocks, undervalued_growth_stocks; default day_gainers).
yfinance 0.2.66 (the version installed with SAJHA at the time of writing) no longer has yf.Screener, so this returns the error form; openbb_equity_discovery_gainers, openbb_equity_discovery_losers and openbb_equity_discovery_active (provider yfinance) cover the same lists. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"screen_type": "most_actives"}
